name: Web Designing
overview: The Web Designing course is designed for learners who want to create attractive, responsive, and user-friendly websites.
description: The course provides practical training in modern web designing concepts and helps learners develop the skills required to design professional websites. It is suitable for beginners, students, freelancers, and aspiring web designers.
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning web designing.
prerequisites: Basic computer knowledge is recommended but not mandatory.

duration.note: Course duration varies. Please contact the academy for details.

fees.note: Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

teaching_methodology: Personalized teaching with practical website designing exercises and individual attention.
study_material: Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.
faculty: Highly qualified, experienced, patient, and supportive faculty members.
learning_outcomes: Build a foundation for frontend development

faqs.question: Who can join the Web Designing course?
faqs.answer: Students, beginners, job seekers, freelancers, working professionals, and anyone interested in designing websites can join.

faqs.question: Do I need programming knowledge?
faqs.answer: No official prerequisite has been specified. Basic computer knowledge is recommended.

faqs.question: Is practical training provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course emphasizes practical website designing through hands-on exercises.

faqs.question: Will I build websites during the course?
faqs.answer: Yes. Practical website designing is an important part of the training.

faqs.question: Do you provide study material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.

faqs.question: How can I know the course duration and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the latest duration and fee details.
